## Profile Summary
Owusu Kenneth builds production web and mobile applications with modern TypeScript stacks, pragmatic AI/LLM integrations, and a strong bias for clean interfaces, ultra-fast performance, and dependable distributed systems.

## Primary Skills
- **Frontend**: React 19, Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, React Native (Expo), Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Radix UI.
- **Backend & AI**: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Django, Vercel AI SDK, OpenRouter, LangChain, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Drizzle ORM.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Google Cloud, CI/CD, Vercel.

## Featured Projects
- **Orin**: AI multi-agent workspace where specialized agents plan, build, test, secure, and optimize applications collaboratively.
- **Docsage / Docsage v2**: Developer tooling turning repository metadata and codebase ASTs into clear, structured README documentation.
- **eMart**: AI-powered multivendor ecommerce platform designed around scalable architecture and administrative ergonomics.
- **React Native Auth Template**: Production-ready Expo and Supabase starter with biometric authentication and clean scaffolding.
- **Google Meet Clone**: Low-latency WebRTC video conferencing system with presence tracking and WebSocket signaling.
